Sent on every inference and model-discovery request (joined into the CLI's `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS`).\n\nUse this for fleet-wide constants. For per-user or per-session values, have the **credential helper script** emit JSON with a `headers` field; those are merged over these static entries (helper wins on conflict).
會傳送到每個推論與模型探索請求（會合併進 CLI 的 `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS`）。\n\n用於全員固定常數。對於按使用者或按工作階段變動的值，請讓**憑證輔助腳本**輸出帶有 `headers` 欄位的 JSON；這些值會覆蓋這裡的靜態項目（衝突時輔助腳本優先）。

Claude runs the executable with no arguments and reads **stdout** (trimmed). Exit code must be `0`; any output on **stderr** is logged but ignored. **Stdout must contain only one of the formats below** (no banners, prompts, or log lines).

**Output format** is either:
- a single bare token (the API key / bearer token), or
- a JSON object `{"token": "...", "headers": {"Name": "Value", ...}}` when per-request headers are needed (merged over **Custom inference headers**, helper wins on conflict)

Result is cached for the TTL below. On TTL expiry the helper is re-invoked transparently (no user prompt, no relaunch).

**Typical use:** a shell script that pulls from Keychain, 1Password CLI, or an internal secret broker. Example:

`security find-generic-password -s anthropic-api -w`

If this field is set, static credential fields (API key, bearer token) are ignored. The helper always wins.

Claude 會以無參數方式執行該可執行檔，並讀取 **stdout**（去除首尾空白）。結束代碼必須為 `0`；**stderr** 上的任何輸出都會被記錄但會被忽略。**Stdout 只能包含以下格式之一**（不要有橫幅、提示或日誌行）。

**輸出格式** 為：
- 一個裸 token（API 密鑰 / bearer token），或
- 一個 JSON 物件 `{"token": "...", "headers": {"Name": "Value", ...}}`，用於需要依請求設定請求標頭的情境（會覆蓋**自訂推論請求標頭**，衝突時輔助腳本優先）

結果會依下方 TTL 快取。TTL 到期後會透明地重新呼叫輔助腳本（不會提示使用者，也不需要重新啟動）。

**典型用途：** 從 Keychain、1Password CLI 或內部密鑰代理擷取憑證的 shell 腳本。範例：

`security find-generic-password -s anthropic-api -w`

設定此欄位後，靜態憑證欄位（API 密鑰、bearer token）會被忽略。輔助腳本永遠優先。

Only affects **tool calls**. Inference and MCP traffic are covered by their own allowlists elsewhere.

When unset, only the inference endpoint is reachable from the sandbox; the agent's package installs (pip/npm) and web fetches will fail with a 403.

Accepts exact hostnames (`api.github.com`), wildcards (`*.corp.com` matches one subdomain level), and `*` to allow all.

Wildcards don't cross schemes. `*.corp.com` matches `docs.corp.com` but not `corp.com` itself; add both if you need the apex.

IP literals and localhost always resolve regardless of this list; this is a public-egress filter, not a sandbox.

Hosts you add here also need to be open on your network firewall. See **Egress Requirements** for the full allowlist.

萬用字元不會跨越層級。`*.corp.com` 符合 `docs.corp.com`，但不符合 `corp.com` 本身；如果需要根網域，請兩者都新增。

"Essential" means the signals Anthropic needs to keep your deployment working: **crash stacks**, **startup failure reasons**, and **version/OS metadata**. No prompts, completions, file contents, or identifiers beyond a random install ID.

**What you lose when this is on:** when a Cowork build hits a bug that only reproduces on your OS version or locale, Anthropic can't see it unless a user manually reports. Fixes ship slower.

**Why this is discouraged, not blocked:** some air-gapped environments require zero outbound telemetry as a matter of policy. The switch exists for them. If you don't have that constraint, leave it off.

「必要」指 Anthropic 維持你的部署正常運作所需的信號：**崩潰堆疊**、**啟動失敗原因**和**版本/OS 中繼資料**。不包含提示、補全、檔案內容，也不包含隨機安裝 ID 以外的識別碼。

**啟用此項會失去什麼：** 當 Cowork 建置遇到只在你的 OS 版本或地區設定下重現的 bug 時，除非使用者手動回報，否則 Anthropic 看不到。修正發布會更慢。

**為什麼不建議但不阻止：** 一些隔離網絡環境因政策要求零輸出診斷資料。此開關就是為它們準備的。如果你沒有這個限制，請保持關閉。

"Nonessential" covers two things: **product-usage analytics** (which features get used, navigation patterns; no prompts or completions) and the **Send** action in Help → Generate Diagnostic Report. Turning this on stops both.\n\nDestination for both: `claude.ai`. Already listed under Egress Requirements → Nonessential telemetry.

Applies to both the Cowork and Code tabs. In the Cowork tab it governs the sandbox's web fetch, shell commands, and package installs. In the Code tab it is translated into Claude Code's network sandbox allowlist (claude.com); a separately deployed Claude Code managed-settings file on the endpoint takes precedence by default.
適用於 Cowork 和 Code 分頁。在 Cowork 分頁中，它控制沙盒的網頁擷取、shell 命令和套件安裝。在 Code 分頁中，它會轉換為 Claude Code 的網絡沙盒允許清單（claude.com）；預設情況下，端點上另行部署的 Claude Code 受管理設定檔優先。
Does not apply to Web Search, which runs server-side at your inference provider rather than from the sandbox.
不適用於 Web Search；它在你的推論提供者伺服器端執行，而不是從沙盒中執行。
Only affects tool calls. Inference and MCP traffic are covered by their own allowlists elsewhere.
僅影響工具呼叫。推論和 MCP 流量由其他位置的各自允許清單控制。
When unset, only the inference endpoint is reachable from the sandbox; the agent's package installs (pip/npm) and web fetches will fail with a 403.
未設定時，沙盒只能連到推論端點；代理程式的套件安裝（pip/npm）和網頁擷取會因 403 失敗。

Accepts exact hostnames ( api.github.com ), wildcards ( *.corp.com matches one subdomain level), and * to allow all. *.corp.com matches docs.corp.com but not corp.com itself; add both if you need the apex. IP literals and localhost always resolve regardless of this list; this is a public-egress filter, not a sandbox.
接受精確主機名稱（api.github.com）、萬用字元（*.corp.com 符合一層子網域）以及用於允許全部的 *。*.corp.com 符合 docs.corp.com，但不符合 corp.com 本身；如果需要根網域，請兩者都新增。IP 字面值和 localhost 一律可解析，不受此清單影響；這是公開輸出過濾器，不是沙盒。
Hosts you add here also need to be open on your network firewall. See Egress Requirements for the full allowlist.
你在這裡新增的主機還需要在網絡防火牆中開放。完整允許清單請參閱「輸出要求」。
Folders users may attach as a workspace. Leave unset for unrestricted access. Supports ~ and a fixed set of environment variables.
使用者可作為工作區附加的資料夾。留空則不限制存取。支援 ~ 和一組固定的環境變數。

Paths can reference ~ and these environment variables, expanded per user: %OneDrive%, %OneDriveCommercial%, %OneDriveConsumer%, %APPDATA%, %LOCALAPPDATA%, %USERNAME%, %XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR%. The set is fixed; an entry that references any other %VAR%, or one that is unset on the device, is ignored.
路徑可以引用 ~ 和這些環境變數，並按使用者展開：%OneDrive%、%OneDriveCommercial%、%OneDriveConsumer%、%APPDATA%、%LOCALAPPDATA%、%USERNAME%、%XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR%。該集合是固定的；引用其他 %VAR% 或裝置上未設定變數的項目會被忽略。

When enabled, users can select Auto mode (Code tab) / Act without asking (Cowork tab). Claude runs a safety classifier on each action and only prompts for approval on actions it judges risky, instead of following the static per-tool policy.
啟用後，使用者可以選擇自動模式（Code 分頁）/ 無需詢問即可操作（Cowork 分頁）。Claude 會對每個操作執行安全分類器，並且只在判定為有風險的操作上要求核准，而不是遵循靜態的按工具政策。

Requires a model that supports the classifier (Claude 4.6+). Older models show the option greyed out. builtinToolPolicy and this key may both be set; Auto mode is a user-selectable option alongside the default policy, not a replacement for it.
需要支援該分類器的模型（Claude 4.6+）。較舊模型會將此選項顯示為灰色。builtinToolPolicy 和此鍵可以同時設定；自動模式是預設政策旁邊的使用者可選項，而不是它的替代品。
In the Code tab, a separately deployed Claude Code managed-settings file that sets disableAutoMode to "disable" overrides this key and keeps Auto mode hidden.
在 Code 分頁中，如果另行部署的 Claude Code 受管理設定檔將 disableAutoMode 設為 "disable"，則會覆寫此鍵並保持隱藏自動模式。
停用內建技能和工作流程

Disables Claude Code's bundled skills and workflows (deep-research and similar). Use where they cannot function, for instance when WebFetch is egress-blocked and the gateway does not forward the WebSearch server tool.
停用 Claude Code 內建的技能和工作流程（deep-research 及類似功能）。適用於它們無法運作的情境，例如 WebFetch 被輸出阻擋且網關未轉發 WebSearch 伺服器工具時。

Allow Claude to run code in a local sandbox to analyze attached files it can't read natively — like Excel and PowerPoint — and perform inline data analysis. The sandbox can only read files attached to the conversation and has no network access. Off by default.
允許 Claude 在本機沙盒中執行代碼，以分析它無法原生讀取的附件檔案，例如 Excel 和 PowerPoint，並執行內嵌數據分析。沙盒只能讀取附加到對話中的檔案，且沒有網絡存取權限。預設關閉。

For OAuth-authenticated entries, the app builds the redirect URI as http://<callbackHost>:<callbackPort>/callback ; register that exact value with the OAuth provider. Tokens refresh automatically during a session, so users aren't interrupted when the initial access token expires.
對於透過 OAuth 驗證的項目，應用程式會將重新導向 URI 建構為 http://<callbackHost>:<callbackPort>/callback；請在 OAuth 提供者處註冊這個精確值。權杖會在工作階段期間自動重新整理，因此初始存取權杖過期時不會打斷使用者。

toolPolicy locks the per-tool approval state. "blocked" removes the tool from the session and labels it admin-blocked. "ask" requires approval on every call (Allow once / Deny only; no persistent always-allow). "allow" pre-approves. Tools not listed follow the user's choice: the prompt offers a persistent Always allow, except for tools that can modify data, which instead show a session-scoped Allow for this task alongside Allow for all tasks with a malicious-instruction warning. In the Code tab, blocked / ask are forwarded as Claude Code permission rules; allow is not.

toolPolicy 會鎖定每個工具的核准狀態。"blocked" 會從工作階段中移除該工具，並標記為管理員封鎖。"ask" 要求每次呼叫都核准（僅允許一次/拒絕；沒有持久的永遠允許）。"allow" 會預先核准。未列出的工具遵循使用者選擇：提示會提供持久的「永遠允許」；但對於可修改數據的工具，會改為顯示限於工作階段的「允許此任務」，並同時顯示帶惡意指令警告的「允許所有任務」。在 Code 分頁中，blocked / ask 會轉發為 Claude Code 權限規則；allow 不會。

A UUID you generate. Tags telemetry so Anthropic support can locate your fleet's events. If unset, a shared placeholder UUID is sent and your events can't be distinguished from other unconfigured deployments. Not used for auth.
